QuestInfo.name: Legacy of Larelle 1
QuestInfo.0: What did #p2430001# do to #p2430000# for summoning the monster that damaged Henesys? And where exactly was #p2430000#? #b#p2430003##k in #b#MDmap323090100##k seemed to be the only one with answers.
QuestInfo.1: It seemed that #b#p2430004##k would know where #p2430000# had been locked up, but getting the answer would be difficult. Alpha and Beta would have to use their charms... or find some weakness to exploit.
QuestInfo.2: #p2430004#, the security chief of #m323000000#, held the answers they needed. It was time to turn on the charm.

0.0: Stan and Mark had Larelle the last time I saw him. I don't know where they took him.
0.1: It can't have been too far. I've been keeping an eye on Mark, and he disappears for short trips sometimes. I'd bet he was checking up on Larelle.

yes.0: Maybe you can trick #bMark#k into telling you where he's got Larelle. You just have to play your cards right. I suggest you get on his good side first, then make your move.
yes.1: But, if you can't do it the nice way... Let's just say, he's a fan of Rina. He gets kind of dumb when she's the subject of conversation...

1.0: Hello there. Are you the two who helped Rina? You really do like identical... Are you twins? That's some good genes you got there. You think you could help me out?
